title: The Calculus of Value
summary:
While the title may have raised concern for readers, my main conclusion was that the
elevated US stock market valuations at the time didn't necessarily signal the existence
of a bubble, mainly because Some investors emphasize paying a reasonable price for today's earning power and others
are willing to bet on what they see as potential growth in earning power. Some investors find another company sexy and right for the future, and others think
it's a risky high flyer.
